nodes.label: Weekly 7-Episode Batch
nodes.rationale: 5 episodes on currentTheme and 2 on testTheme (slots 3 and 6) so a candidate theme is tested each week; topic priority follow-ups, then competitor-inspired topics, then themes.json ideas; never repeat a topic.

nodes.label: YouTube Inauthentic Content Policy
nodes.rationale: Template-like repetitive videos lose monetization; variety in topic, hook, layout, pacing and accuracy are the defence.

nodes.label: Weekly Review Pull Request
nodes.rationale: Body follows an exact checklist shape because the apply review workflow parses it; unticking rejects an episode or theme switch.

nodes.label: Brand Accounts (YouTube + Instagram, EN/ID)
nodes.rationale: A broad brand name fits every theme in themes.json; Instagram accounts must be Creator accounts linked to a Facebook Page to post from code and read competitors.

nodes.label: GitHub Repository Configuration
nodes.rationale: main must be default because scheduled workflows only run there; Actions need read/write and PR creation for preview comments.

nodes.label: Instagram Graph API Setup
nodes.rationale: App stays in Development mode so the admin can use own accounts without App Review; Page access tokens from me/accounts never expire.

nodes.label: YouTube Data and Analytics API Setup
nodes.norm_label: youtube data and analytics api setup
nodes.rationale: OAuth app must be published to production; in Testing the login expires every 7 days and posting stops.

nodes.label: YouTube API Project Audit
nodes.rationale: New API projects may have uploads forced private until audited; meanwhile publish by hand from preview links.

nodes.label: strategy.json
nodes.rationale: Lessons capped at 10 short actionable items; thresholds never edited unless the human asks; a switch starts the week after the batch.

nodes.label: One-Time Setup
nodes.rationale: Keys go only into GitHub Actions secrets, never into a chat.

nodes.label: Fact-Checking Rule
nodes.rationale: A wrong fact is worse than a weak video; at least 2 sources, preferring primary ones.

nodes.label: Keep/Switch Theme Decision
nodes.rationale: Computed in code so the reviewing model must not redo or override the arithmetic.

nodes.label: Narration Rules
nodes.rationale: 6-8 scenes, 90-150 English words; hook under 2 seconds; natural casual Indonesian rather than literal translation.

nodes.label: Never Rules (no posting, no credentials, no workflow-owned files)
nodes.norm_label: never rules (no posting, no credentials, no workflow-owned files)

nodes.label: Visual Rules
nodes.rationale: Each scene shows the mechanism with its own diagram, no layout reuse, diagrams kept between y=220 and y=1300 to leave room for captions.

nodes.label: Weekly Review Procedure
nodes.rationale: A weekly Claude session reviews numbers and writes next week's batch as one PR; a human approves by merging, keeping a human gate on everything posted.
